generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's vine species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), family 47 Araliaceae: mostly woody, some climbing by aerial roots (ivy); leaves alternate, rarely opposite; stipules joined to the leaf stalk's base or within it, rarely absent; flowers regular, in umbels, racemes or heads; calyx small on an inferior ovary; petals often 5; fruit a berry or drupe.
